coverage.why: All seven accounting areas and industry_lens carry a finding and a verdict, and all financial sections (the six areas, dupont and path_to_distress) carry a reading. The gate dropped only financial anomalies[14] and three accounting adjustments, never a whole area or section.

calibration.why: Each area verdict restates the anomalies listed under it. For example, the cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sheet verdict names the financing-classified payments, investment gains, commitment book and calculator-invisible debt, and each is an anomaly in that area. No verdict runs against its anomalies.

valuation_reading.why: market.missing, valuation.missing and implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing leave no price, no implied growth and no sensitivity grid. The reading reports this correctly, but it cannot place the price or the implied growth, and its two sensitive assumptions are reasoned, not computed by the calculator.
